name: 02-import-then-quit
script: const trip = await window.api.createTrip({ title: '续跑验证', startDate: '2026-09-05', endDate: '2026-09-06' }); window.__e2e = { tripId: trip.id }; const SRC = ['/tmp/gallery-demo/album-small/dali-erhai-2026/DSC050001.jpg', '/tmp/gallery-demo/album-small/dali-erhai-2026/DSC050009.jpg', '/tmp/gallery-demo/album-small/dali-erhai-2026/DSC050017.jpg']; const one = []; for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) one.push(...SRC); const res = await window.api.importPhotos(trip.id, one); if (res.photos.length !== 600) throw new Error('导入数量不对: ' + res.photos.length); const albumId = await window.api.getActiveAlbumId(); const trips = await window.api.listTrips(albumId); const t = trips.find(x => x.id === trip.id); const ready = t ? t.photos.filter(p => p.thumbStatus === 'ready').length : -1; return { imported: res.photos.length, readyAtQuit: ready }
